Extremely solid and high-quality woodworking vise for a very affordable price. It’s heavy-duty, well-built, and offers incredible value for the money. Highly recommended for any workshop.

This was far easier to install than some of the bigger ones I've purchased before. The only complaint I could have with this would be the lack of padding on the inside of the Jaws. Personally I would recommend getting cork sheets with adhesive to protect the wood.
Love this trolley my boss saw it and bought 2 next day great bit of gear
Great heavy duty folding miter saw table. Very well built and a very good price. Saves me a lot of shop space when folded and saw is not in use!!
Sturdy and easy to use. Instructions are a little tough to follow but still a great unit

A great table, once you get it built. While some have spoken about how easy they found the build/assembly, I'm not one of them. The diagrams are like some sort of MC Escher diagram..so much so I went over to YouTube to seek help. The other reason I docked one star was that the threading on some of the nuts and bolts was not great. Saying that, once built it's made moving my DeWalt table saw much more pleasant and the price can't be beat. All to say, if you buy it, once built, you'll likely love it.

Great outdoor vice at the shop. No problems works great.

If you need something that’s going to hold your big or small pipe every time you slap it in there this is the chain vice you want! Doesn’t matter the size. Small white pvc pipe, big black gas line she grips it like a champ and will make sure to help you get the job done. I’m cranking my pipe on this bad boy all day everyday till I go blind. She a durable work horse. Worth the money!
